details:
### Summary

Claude permission replies could omit owner authorization. In affected versions, an authorized non-owner channel sender could approve or deny a pending Claude Code permission request through the MCP channel bridge.

This advisory is scoped to Claude permission prompts delivered through configured message channels. It does not change OpenClaw's shared-agent model; the failed boundary is the explicit owner requirement for resolving host permission requests.

### Impact

When a Claude Code run was waiting for permission, a non-owner sender with channel command access could approve an action intended for the owner. Practical impact depends on the pending action and the host capabilities requested by Claude Code.

### Patched Versions

The first stable patched version is `2026.7.1`.

### Mitigations

upgrade to `openclaw@2026.7.1` or later. Before upgrading, avoid delivering Claude permission prompts to channels with non-owner participants and cancel unattended pending requests.
summary: Claude permission replies could omit owner authorization
